generationLineage.promptText: Create one original photorealistic editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. A fictional Black British woman B2B software founder in her early forties, individual natural features, short natural curls, dark navy tailored jacket over simple ivory shirt, engaged in a thoughtful interview, hands anatomically credible and relaxed. Medium close portrait at eye level, 75mm-equivalent perspective, subject on right half with full head, shoulders and hands comfortably inside crop. Quiet contemporary European studio: pale plaster foreground wall, deep navy shelving 2.5 metres behind, one small warm lamp distant, soft defocused architectural depth. Large soft key from upper camera-left, modest fill, restrained cool blue edge, natural skin and eyes, subtle texture, no beauty retouch gloss. Calm intelligent luxurious editorial feeling, white and cobalt/neutral environment, sophisticated depth. No logos, no text, no interface, no frame, no watermarks. This is fictional demonstration media, no real customer or public figure. Do not create cyberpunk, chrome room, studio stock-photo grin or plastic skin.
